sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: BioCLIP Ecosystem | Foundation Models for the Tree of Life
sources.snippet: BioCLIP (Original) The original foundation model presented in "BioCLIP: A Vision Foundation Model for the Tree of Life". It established the standard for using CLIP architectures in organismal biology. Trained on the TreeOfLife-10M dataset, it covers over 450,000 taxa and learns a hierarchical representation that aligns with the biological taxonomy.
